purpose: Result-blind dense sampled angular-support sensitivity over the documented 0.75-degree-radius Koomen field, without inventing the unknown within-field acceptance function.

historicalAudit.acceptanceFunction: unknown; no top-hat or fitted weighting is authorized

profileCase.classification: independently retrieved proxy vertical extinction profile; not exact measured atmosphere

directionGrid.classification: dense sampled support envelope only; not a proof of continuous extrema between samples

mystic.intentionalCommonRandomNumbers: within each row/replicate, one fresh seed is reused across all sampled directions and both physical cases; rows and replicates have distinct seeds

ciePhotopic.classification: conditional standard-photopic diagnostic matching the historical light-adapted-eye intent; not claimed as exact 1952 installed response
ciePhotopic.source: reviewed CIE V(lambda) constants already present on main; external cross-reference CIE spectral luminous efficiency for photopic vision DOI 10.25039/CIE.DS.dktna2s3

originalSqm.classification: SQM-conditional diagnostic retained only for connection to Issue #828; not the Koomen spectral operator

fixedFromIssue828.spectralPhaseOpticalPropertyFamily: aerosol_default; only CAMS proxy vertical tau allocation differs in the profile case

analysis.uncertainty: mean, sample SD, SE, and two-sided Student-t 95% CI across four independent replicate seed bases
